title: Disability representation on county commissions
summary: At the Commission on Persons with Disabilities, a commissioner asked to discuss giving people with disabilities a seat on every commission. A month later a commissioner who described harsh treatment during an arrest asked that someone who understands disability sit on the police commission.

timeline.text: A commissioner described harsh treatment by police during an arrest and asked that someone who understands disability sit on the police commission.
A commissioner asked to discuss giving people with disabilities a seat on every commission.
